sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
-----
For the Petitioner : Mr. Ritesh Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. V.S. Sahay, A.P.P. .....
Order No.05/ Dated:14.06.2024
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2.  The petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Chainpur P.S. Case No. 41 of 2023,
registered for the offence under Section 406, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gumla.
3.
As per FIR, there is allegation of withdrawal of money of Rs. Twenty Five Lacs from the joint account of informant's mother by the accused person.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all as alleged in the FIR.
The petitioner is languishing in Judicial custody since 06.01.2024 without rhymes and reasons.

It is submitted that there was no agreement with the petitioner and the informant in respect of any transaction of money and not a single penny is deposited in the account of the petitioner or he has received any amount rather there is simple allegation that in place of petitioner, co-accused, Pawan Kumar Yadav has filled the name of petitioner in the agreement.
Petitioner has never sworned affidavit rather the same was done by co-accused Pawan Kumar Yadav.

Main co-accused, Pawan Kumar Yadav who is beneficiary of the transaction has been granted anticipatory bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in A.B.A. No.
10300 of 2023 vide order dated 19.01.2024 on the undertaking that he will deposit Rs. 22,00,000/-
(Rs. Twenty Two Lacs) without prejudice to the defence.
Petitioner has no criminal antecedent.

Petitioner undertakes to co-operate in the trial of the case by remaining physically present as and when required by the concerned trial court and shall abide by all terms and conditions as imposed in the matter of granting bail and shall not indulge in any manner in tampering with the prosecution evidences or influencing the witnesses of prosecution, hence, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.

5. Learned A.P.P appearing on behalf of State has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and submitted that although Pawan Kumar Yadav has been granted anticipatory bail by the Co-ordinate Ujjawal Sengupta vs The State Of Jharkhand on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177252339/
1 Bench of this Court with condition to deposit Rs. 22,000,00/- (Twenty Two Lacs) but he didn't return the money to the informant nor surrender before the court and has not obeyed the order of the anticipatory bail application as yet.

entities.text: ordinate Ujjawal Sengupta vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is collision between the main accused and present petitioner on whose assurance informant's mother has deposited the money.
Therefore, in case of failure of return of money the petitioner will reimburse the amount to the informant.
The petitioner is co- responsible alongwith the main accused, hence he does not deserve bail.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the nature of transaction between the informant and the main accused and also the relationship between the present petitioner and also in view of the fact that petitioner is remanded in judicial custody since six months, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 40,000/-(Rupees Forty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gumla in connection with Chainpur P.S. Case No. 41 of 2023 subject to the conditions:-
(1) Petitioner shall remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial of this case unless prevented from sufficient cause to the satisfaction of the learned trial court.
(2) Petitioner shall not indulge in any or other similar offence till the conclusion of the trial.
(3) Petitioner shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidences or influencing the prosecution witnesses.
In case of violation of the aforesaid condition the bail of the petitioner shall be cancelled and shall be taken into custody by the learned trial court itself.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
